narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The magic is in the numbers, so any order keeps it.
<bookmark mark='swap'/>Swap minus ten and three in the blue grid, and play the game again.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Circle three, minus seven, minus one and four. They add up to minus one, not minus fourteen.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The same numbers in a different order lose the magic, so the arrangement matters.

narration: <bookmark mark='twice'/>To check a grid you have made, play the game on it twice with different circles.
